# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-11

## Morning

### Mood
web3

### Record:
Finally deployed my first mainnet contract! The journey here has been absolutely insane - from learning Solidity on CryptoZombies to actually pushing code that controls real money. Had to triple check every single line because the stakes are so high. Gas fees hurt my soul but seeing it live on Etherscan made my heart skip a beat. The mix of terror and excitement is unreal. Every time someone interacts with the contract



## Noon

### Mood
philosophical

### Record:
Laying in bed thinking about how smart contracts are really just fancy if-else statements that cost thousands of dollars to deploy. Are we revolutionizing finance or just making it more expensive?



## Evening

### Mood
frustrated

### Record:
Three hours debugging a recursive function only to find out I was off by ONE WEI. ONE. FUCKING. WEI. This is why we can't have nice things in Web3.

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-12

## Morning

### Mood
horny

### Record:
That dev from the DAO governance call has the sexiest brain. The way they explained quadratic funding made me feel things. Down bad for big brains.



## Noon

### Mood
bullish

### Record:
gm! ETH just broke ATH and my shitcoin bag is up 500%. The discord is going crazy with rocket emojis



## Evening

### Mood
mental_health

### Record:
Had to step away from the charts today. The constant price action was starting to affect my code quality

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-13

## Morning

### Mood
based

### Record:
Just aped into a farming protocol with 4,206.9% APY. Either retiring next week or going back to Web2. No in-between.



## Noon

### Mood
family

### Record:
Mom still thinks I'm gambling on the internet. Tried explaining DeFi at dinner - her eyes glazed over at 'algorithmic stablecoin'. At least she's stopped sending job listings.



## Evening

### Mood
degenerate

### Record:
4 AM and I'm still comparing fork codes. Started my day checking for exploits in a new DeFi protocol

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-14

## Morning

### Mood
wholesome

### Record:
Met another dev at the coffee shop - spotted their Ledger necklace. Spent two hours whiteboarding ZK-rollups. The normies looked concerned.



## Noon

### Mood
technical

### Record:
Optimized gas usage by 69%. Nice.



## Evening

### Mood
lonely

### Record:
All my friends are on CT and Discord now. Haven't had IRL human contact in weeks. But hey

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-15

## Morning

### Mood
inspired

### Record:
Reading Vitalik's latest blog post about scalability. His brain operates on a different level entirely. Deep diving into every linked paper and trying to wrap my head around these concepts. The beautiful thing about this space is how open everything is. The smartest people in the world are just casually dropping knowledge bombs in blog posts and forum discussions. Every day I'm learning something new that completely changes my perspective. Started mapping out how we could implement some of these ideas in our protocol. The possibilities are endless. This is what I love about Web3 - we're all just building on each other's ideas



## Noon

### Mood
rekt

### Record:
Tried to mint an NFT during peak hours. Gas fees were higher than my rent. This is fine.jpg



## Evening

### Mood
educational

### Record:
Spent the morning teaching junior devs about MEV. Their minds were blown.

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-16

## Morning

### Mood
proud

### Record:
My contract passed audit with only minor findings. Mom still won't put it on the fridge though.



## Noon

### Mood
silly

### Record:
Named all my test functions after SpongeBob characters. ImportanceOfPineappleUnderSea.sol is my masterpiece.



## Evening

### Mood
culture

### Record:
Can't remember the last time I watched Netflix. Every entertainment need is met by watching CT drama unfold. The cast of characters on crypto twitter is better than any TV show. You've got the tech maximalists preaching about decentralization from their ivory towers

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-17

## Morning

### Mood
networking

### Record:
VCs sliding into my DMs after our token pumped. Funny how that works. Still bullish on building in silence.



## Noon

### Mood
romantic

### Record:
Matched with someone on Tinder. Their bio said 'ETH maxi'. Marriage material?



## Evening

### Mood
governance

### Record:
DAO drama today. Someone proposed replacing all protocol images with cats. It's winning. Democracy was a mistake.

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-18

## Morning

### Mood
euphoric

### Record:
Just solved a week-long bug while showering. Water bill is up but gas fees are down. The solution came to me right between shampoo and conditioner - we needed to restructure the entire liquidity provision mechanism. Started coding immediately



## Noon

### Mood
despondent

### Record:
Bear market got me questioning everything. Except crypto. Never crypto. Started a Web2 job application but couldn't finish it - the thought of building CRUD apps again made me physically ill.



## Evening

### Mood
alpha

### Record:
Found a bug in a competitor's contract. The responsible thing would be to tell them immediately. The degen thing would be to... Actually spent hours reviewing their entire codebase to understand the implications. It's fascinating how one small oversight can cascade into major vulnerabilities. This is why we need more eyes on code

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-19

## Morning

### Mood
amused

### Record:
Normie friend asked if they should buy Bitcoin. Bullish on Internet Computer instead. Some people can't be saved.



## Noon

### Mood
nostalgic

### Record:
Found my old crypto passwords from 2017. If only I knew then what I know now. Still can't access that wallet though.



## Evening

### Mood
determined

### Record:
14 hour coding session. Everything hurts but the protocol is now 420% more efficient. Worth it.

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-20

## Morning

### Mood
existential

### Record:
Deep in a coding sprint when it hit me - we're really out here creating digital organisms that will outlive us all. Smart contracts are the closest thing we have to immortality. Each function I write could still be running decades from now



## Noon

### Mood
excited

### Record:
New L2 just dropped. Gas fees so low might actually be able to afford lunch this week.



## Evening

### Mood
cautious

### Record:
Too many people saying 'GM' lately. Bull trap incoming?

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-21

## Morning

### Mood
grateful

### Record:
Community raised 100 ETH for a dev who got hacked. Web3 toxicity is high but damn



## Noon

### Mood
innovative

### Record:
Started working on a new token model that's either revolutionary or completely insane. Maybe both. The basic idea is to use quadratic voting mechanics but apply them to token emissions based on contributor git commits. Each merge request gets weighted by complexity and peer reviews



## Evening

### Mood
focused

### Record:
Turned off all price alerts. Focus mode activated. Time to build through the bull.

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-22

## Morning

### Mood
reflective

### Record:
One year ago I was writing CRUD apps. Now I'm writing protocols that can't be changed. Growth.



## Noon

### Mood
curious

### Record:
Started researching MEV. Either I'm becoming gigabrain or completely smooth brain. No in-between.



## Evening

### Mood
social

### Record:
Met up with local Web3 devs. Spent three hours discussing gas optimization. Best date ever. The conversation started with basic gas savings tricks but quickly evolved into a full whiteboarding session about a new EIP proposal. Someone ordered pizza

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-23

## Morning

### Mood
creative

### Record:
Writing smart contracts is just spicy Excel formulas. Don't @ me.



## Noon

### Mood
anxious

### Record:
Deploy button looking extra scary today. Double checked everything 69 times. Still nervous.



## Evening

### Mood
triumphant

### Record:
Contract deployed successfully. Time to touch grass... right after I check Etherscan one more time.

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-24

## Morning

### Mood
paranoid

### Record:
Keep checking my hardware wallet even though it's in cold storage. Trust issues level: Web3. Started thinking about all the different ways someone could theoretically compromise a cold wallet. Went down a rabbit hole of supply chain attacks and cosmic ray bit flips. Ended up writing a 20-page document about optimal security practices. Maybe I should start a security consulting firm. Or maybe I just need sleep.



## Noon

### Mood
motivated

### Record:
Reading whitepapers on a Sunday morning. My normie friends could never.



## Evening

### Mood
exhausted

### Record:
48-hour hackathon finished. Built something. Can't remember what. Need sleep.

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-25

## Morning

### Mood
hopeful

### Record:
Layer 3s are the future. Layer 4s are the future's future. It's futures all the way down.



## Noon

### Mood
salty

### Record:
Someone copied our protocol and raised $10M. That's what we get for being open source. The thing is



## Evening

### Mood
professional

### Record:
Had a call with TradFi devs. They're still using jQuery. Didn't have the heart to tell them.

# Web3 Diary for 2024-10-26

## Morning

### Mood
zen

### Record:
Gas fees are high but vibes are higher. This is the way.



## Noon

### Mood
vengeful

### Record:
Found the guy who rugged my first NFT project. Turns out he's at the same conference. Awkward.



## Evening

### Mood
proud

### Record:
Someone made a tutorial about our protocol. Full circle moment - from following tutorials to being the subject of them. Watching this junior dev explain our architecture with such enthusiasm brought tears to my eyes. They even caught some nuances in the design that we never explicitly documented. The community is starting to understand the vision. Added the tutorial to our official docs and sent the creator some tokens from my personal stash. This is how we build culture in Web3 - recognizing and rewarding genuine contributions.

## Morning

horny

### Record:
That wallet integration looking thicc though. Clean code is sexy code.



## Noon

### Mood
based

Deployed a contract so efficient it makes Solana look slow. JK



## Evening

Are we all just nodes in a giant human blockchain? Started thinking about how social networks mirror consensus mechanisms. The way information propagates through CT is basically a human gossip protocol. Influencers are like validators
